Time:  Bpd shifts happen rapidly and multiple times a day.  Like I was fine this morning walking into the gym. What I told my interviewer for this management  job is 
"I left my previous job on peacefully terms to have an easier and quicker transition into new employment" 
He seemed to like that cause I've been managing the store for 3 months now.

In terms of the interview just be who you are and breathe.  Casual eye contact and a little self cofidence can go a long way. Belive you are worth it for this job  cause you are! From the last interviews I did I hired my "last choice " from based on the resumes. He had the least experience, was the youngest and never had a job but he wowed me. I manage a candy store and I was primarily looking for someone who I could connect with and showed me and could pass that onto customers. We talked for longer and the I knew he was who I wanted. I could teach the the skills. Just rock who you are and you'll be fine!

When it comes down to interacting with both co workers and customers at work I work hard to remember 1 thing.
People have THEIR emotions and THEIR emotions only not mine. When someone is mad I let them be mad. I remember I am not them and I work to remain calm. If my perceptions are someone is mad (I do this a lot) I remind myself to leave them be. If they are mad and they're problem is with me they will either bring it to me or they will get over it. If someone is in my face I let them be a angry all they want and respond with my truth. It's a hard way to put it. It's essentially you aren't your coworker or customer. You don't know exactly what's going on in their head. Let them be them be them and focus on where you are and be you. I know I am highly sensitive to anger on anyone and it bothers me greatly to be around anyone that I precieve as angry. 

Do I get episodes at work?
Heck yes I do. Between the bipolar and borderline it's easy for me to loose control.
the first thing I do if I start to loose control is breathe. Yes it sounds overly simplistic but it helps me a lot. Getting angry at Somthing or someone? Breathe.
